title: 第一卷 第10章 暗中调查
slug: 大明死谏一百次老朱破防了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

程壑川笑了笑，没有解释。

他知道方孝孺是个聪明人，聪明人不需要太多解释。

程壑川从东宫出来之后，没有直接回家，而是去了修史馆。

他得装作什么都没发生的样子，继续跟宋濂讨论元朝帝系的问题。

否则万一有人问起来，他没法解释为什么从东宫出来就慌慌张张地往家跑。

宋濂正在院子里晒书：“今日怎么来晚了？”

“去了趟东宫。”程壑川说。

宋濂手里的书差点掉在地上。

“你去东宫做什么？”老头压低了声音，脸色都变了。

“给太子殿下送一份修史札记。”程壑川面不改色。

宋濂盯着他看了好几秒钟，然后摇了摇头，继续晒书，嘴里嘀咕了一句：“年轻人，胆子太大了。”

程壑川没接话，蹲下来帮他一起晒书。

两个人谁都没再提东宫的事。

但程壑川知道，宋濂心里什么都明白。

这个老头在朝中待了这么多年，见过太多起起落落，什么人能活什么人会死，他一眼就能看出来。

程壑川每天照常去修史馆，照常跟宋濂讨论元史，照常回家整理笔记。

锦衣卫的影子还在，不远不近地跟着。

但程壑川注意到一件事，那个影子的位置，比以前远了十几步。

这意味着什么，他说不准。

但至少不是坏事。

三天后，程壑川正在修史馆抄录一份元代驿站的档案，方孝孺忽然来了。

“程御史，”方孝孺站在门口，面色如常，“殿下请您去一趟东宫。”

程壑川放下笔，看了宋濂一眼。

Page (1/3)

Cheng Hechuan smiled and did not explain.

He knew that Fang Xiaoru was a smart person, and smart people don't need too many explanations.

After Cheng Hechuan came out of the East Palace, he did not go home directly, but went to the History Museum.

He had to pretend that nothing happened and continue to discuss the Yuan Dynasty imperial line with Song Lian.

Otherwise, if someone asked, he would not be able to explain why he ran home in a panic after coming out of the East Palace.

Song Lian was posting books in the yard: "Why are you late today?"

"I went to the East Palace." Cheng Hechuan said.

The book in Song Lian's hand almost fell to the ground.

"What are you doing in the East Palace?" The old man lowered his voice and his face changed.

"Send a copy of the notes on compilation of history to His Highness the Prince." Cheng Hechuan's expression did not change.

Song Lian stared at him for several seconds, then shook his head, continued to post books, and muttered: "Young man, you are too courageous."

Cheng Hechuan didn't answer and squatted down to help him dry the books.

Neither of them mentioned anything about the East Palace.

But Cheng Hechuan knew that Song Lian understood everything in his heart.

This old man has been in the court for so many years and has seen too many ups and downs. He can tell at a glance who will live and who will die.

Cheng Hechuan went to the History Museum as usual every day, discussed Yuan history with Song Lian as usual, and went home to organize his notes as usual.

Jin Yiwei's shadow is still there, following him not far or near.

But Cheng Hechuan noticed one thing. The shadow was more than ten steps further away than before.

What that meant, he couldn't say.

But at least it's not a bad thing.

Three days later, while Cheng Hechuan was copying an archive of a post station in the Yuan Dynasty at the History Museum, Fang Xiaoru suddenly came.

"Cheng Yushi," Fang Xiaoru stood at the door with a normal expression, "Your Highness, please go to the East Palace."

Cheng Hechuan put down his pen and glanced at Song Lian.
